experience.description: Working on corporate software initiatives, migrating legacy Java systems, and delivering new B2B and inventory management solutions in C#, emphasizing logistics business rules, maintenance/evolution, backend features, and collaborative delivery.

Built a machine quality analysis platform with React.js (from prototype to implementation) integrated to Java/Spring REST APIs. Implemented interactive charts and MQTT-driven real-time updates while applying agile practices and Docker to stabilize the environment.

Delivered solutions for healthcare operators using PHP and JavaScript, generating reports, optimizing complex SQL queries, and managing relational data while responding to tickets for fast, quality releases.
